generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

To qualify for award of this contract, each tenderer in his name should have in the last five years period. i.e., 2021-22 ,2022-23 ,2023-24,2024-25 & 2025-26Achieved in at least Two financial years an average annual financial turnover (in all Plantations works /Garden Development/Maintenance works only) of Rs. 10.85 Lakhs.(Usually not less than the estimated annual payment under this contract) (Updated to the FY in which the tenders are invited. Financial turnover of previous years shall be given a weightage of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the financial year in which the tenders are invited).

Eligible Tenderers will be qualified only if their available tender capacity is more than total tender value. The available tender capacity will be calculated as under:Assessed available tender capacity (A x N x 2.5 - B) where,A Maximum value of civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years at 2026-27 price level (updated to the financial year in which the tender is invited) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress.N Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which Tenders are invited.B Value, at 2026-27 price level (updated to the financial year in which the tender is invited) of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 1 Year (period of completion of the works for which Tenders are invited).Note: The statements showing the value of existing commitments and on-going works as well as the stipulated period of completion remaining for each of the works listed should be countersigned by the Employer in charge, not below the rank of an Engineer or equivalent.

itemList.description: Basic Ground Preparation. General cleaning by clearing weeds, shrubs and removing leaves and debris and including sweeping including with all lead and  lift as per  directions of  the officer incharge.(Translated version)

Hedge Plantation Procuring of Ornamental Seedlings for Raising the Hedge.  (Species as per schedule-I)

Raising of Hedge Plantation:- Excvation of trench of size 0.45mX0.45mXL in hard soil  and refilling of  50 % of the trench with the excavated  top soil  and remaing  50 % of the trench with the mixture of ingredient in 1:2:3 proportion i.e. 0.0112 cum  of sand, 0.0224 cum of  farm yard manure and 0.0336 cum of red earth forming uniform mixture. And planting of good quality seedlings. including all lead and lift as per  directions of  the officer incharge. (Translated version)
Shrub Plantation  Procuring of Ornamental Seedlings for Raising the shrubs. etc, complete with all lead and lift as directed by officer in charge.

Raising of Shrubs Plantations:-Excvation of pit of size 0.45mX0.45mX 0.45 m in hard soil  and refilling of  50 % of the pit with the excavated  top soil  and remaing  50 % of the pit with the mixture of ingredient in 1:2:3 proportion i.e. 0.007 cum  of sand, 0.014 cum of  farm yard manure and 0.021 cum of red earth forming uniform mixture. Flower Beds/Ground Cover Procuring of Ornamental Seedlings for Raising the Flower beds/ Ground Cover

Planting of trees is done by digging pits measuring 0.75mx0.75mx0.75m and covering 50% of the plot with topsoil and remaining 50% sand in the ratio of 1:2:3 Sand 0.035 g.m Manure 0.070 g.m Red Soil filling with 0.105 g.mm of mixture and planting of well grown plant is firm soil. etc, complete with all lead and lift as directed by officer in charge.

Providing of 14 inches Cement Flower Pots with Flowering and Other Plants including cost of pot, ingredient mixture and cost of plant  etc, complete with all lead and lift as directed by officer in charge.

Providing of 18 inches Cement Flower Pots with Flowering and Other Plants including cost of pot, ingredient mixture and cost of plant  etc, complete with all lead and lift as directed by officer in charge.

Garden Maintenance work Work to be Under Taken During Maintenance of garden (i)Watering: the plants and lawns in the garden should be watered  frequently as required looking to the climate, soil and plant conditions. If Sprinklers are made availbale it can be used other wise hose pipe can be used for watering problems regarding pipeline damage during watering/ maintenance should be repaired and taken care. (ii) Weeding:-Weeding has to be done reguraly in the entire garden area including extra weed growth in the pathways and other remaining areas in the park. Weeding should be done reguraly once in a fortnight and the weeds collected should be used for preparing manure or it should be disposed from the garden appropriately. (iii) Sweeping:-Sweeping of the garden area has to be done daily. The pathways entire garden area should be swept and kept free of fallen leanves branches ,flowers, dusts, etc. and should be made for the public. Dust bins in the garden area should be emptied and disposed propperly and reguraly. Any dead rodent pets or animals area founds should be removed immediately and the garden spaces should be free from foul smell. Gezeboo, Chairs and other Adomments shouldbe be cleaned daily. (iv) Maintenance of shrubs, Hedges, Ground covers and other area by reguraly pruning so as to maintain the garden aesthetically. (v) Lawn mowing should be done reguraly every fortnight. (vi) Digging of soil around plants in the garden, should be carried out. Soil basins should be prepared around the Hedges/edge/trees/shrubs/ground covers by digging the soil so as to maintain retention of water. This should be done before and after monsoon. (vii) Pruning of plants in the garden, such as the hedges, Trees, Shrubs, Ground Cover plants Topiary plants Rose plants, etc should be carried out as and when required. (viii) Transportation of plastic and other materials should be removed from the garden, must be taken care. The swept leaf materials only should be used for preparation of compost manure in the garden itself and the compost manure should be used in the garden. All dead plants, branches, and other waste materials should be removed regularly  and transported outside the garden. In the garden area dried leaves and other waste materials should be regularly removed from the garden at the risk of contractors. (ix) Garden Labour accommodation and any other accidetns, is soley responsible of contractor. And all other works i.e. protection of garden works to be done  etc, complete with all lead and lift as directed by officer in charge.
Part-I Advance Work:-Aligning in the planting area & marking for pit (without staking). etc, complete with all lead and lift as directed by officer in charge.

Excavation of pits of size 1 m x 1 m x 1 m with vertically cut edges to make an uniform cube and heaping the excavated soil outside the pits (1/3rd top soil to be deposited on the upper side & 2/3rd on the lower side) (ii)In hard soil  etc, complete with all lead and lift as directed by officer in charge.

Part-II Raising of Plantation:-Refilling of Pits, cutting of edge of the pit on the lower side refilling 50% of the pit with the excavated soil, duly breaking the clods & formation of saucer shaped mound on the lower side, of the pit. Qty=8400 X 1 Cum X 50% =4200 Cum  etc, complete with all lead and lift as directed by officer in charge.

Supply of Ingredient, farmyard manure,  required for raising the plantations  inclusive of transportation, breaking of clods, and heaping at plantation site. FYM @ 0.1 cum  etc, complete with all lead and lift as directed by officer in charge.

Supply of Ingredient, Fertile-earth required for filling  in the excavated pits for plantation inclusive of transportation, breaking of clods, and heaping at plantation site. etc, complete with all lead and lift as directed by officer in charge.
Application of Ingredients Farmyard Manure  and Red Earth ( to each pit ) etc, complete with all lead and lift as directed by officer in charge.

Procurement, Transportation & fixing of 10 feet length & 10-15 cm girth Marihala Bamboo/ wooden Stakes. Each of the Bamboo/ wooden stakes is to be dipped in hot liquid coal tar to a minimum length of 5 feet - Vijayapur, Bagalkot, Gadag, Division. (6000 X 25%)  etc, complete with all lead and lift as directed by officer in charge.

Refilling of Pits, cutting of edge of the pit on the lower side refilling 75% of the pit with the excavated soil, duly breaking the clods & formation of saucer shaped mound on the lower side, of the pit.  etc, complete with all lead and lift as directed by officer in charge.

Transportation:- Transportation of polythene-bagged seedlings in hired truck from the nursery site to planting site.  14X20 Pb seedlings.(31 to 40 Km)  etc, complete with all lead and lift as directed by officer in charge.

Unloading of polythene bagged seedling: Loading of polythene-bagged seedlings into the vehicle at the nursery site and unloading at the site nearest to the planting site  Seedlings raised in 14"x20" size bags. etc, complete with all lead and lift as directed by officer in charge.

Conveyance of tall seedlings raised in HDPE bags of size 14"x20" from the dumping point to the planting site near each pit on head load, fixing the supporting stake firmly in the pit, planting the tall seedling in the pit tying the seedling to the supporting stake at 3 points (excluding cost of supporting stake) (14"x20" planting.)  etc, complete with all lead and lift as directed by officer in charge.
Purchase of DAP (100 gms per plant X 2times X 6000)  etc, complete with all lead and lift as directed by officer in charge.

Application of chemical fertilizer around the plants about 15 cm. away in a furrow duly covering with soil (excluding the cost of fertilizer) in two equal split doses. (2 times)  etc, complete with all lead and lift as directed by officer in charge.

Saucer Bharav: Scraping out of grass and weeds to a radius of 50 cms around the plant, earthening up of plants in the form of a semi-circular slanting saucer shape slope, loosening of boulders if any with soil with the help of pickaxe and arranging the loosened boulders and soil in semi-circular fashion at the lower side of the plant (Dimension 80 cms diameter and 25 cms depth at deepest point)  etc, complete with all lead and lift as directed by officer in charge.

Second  & subsequent weeding around the plants (Pit) to radius of 60 cm.  etc, complete with all lead and lift as directed by officer in charge.
